_readme: Every voice on /voices, in page order. Adding a voice = one entry here plus its sample file under public/audio/voices/. functions/voices/index.js renders the cards from this list, functions/voices/[id].js the profile pages, and functions/download/voice/[id].js redirects to each entry's download. id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and never guide/submit/release/thanks/contributors/account. status: live, or soon (listed with a placeholder, no sample or download yet). download: the zip on a GitHub release, or null for a voice that comes with the add-on. Optional: bio (profile page; blank lines split paragraphs), samples (profile page; defaults to sample), avatar, curseforge, owner (a contributor's account id), version (a pack published on its own on the voices release: lore.voicepack publish-studio, LOR-621), donated (true for a voice made from a recording lent on /voices/lend: its pages say "voice by <credit>"; publish with lore.donation publish, which makes the owner row). Copy rule: never say how a voice is made. packs (optional): a voice's extra downloads, each {id, name, addon, clips, coverage, download}: its lands packs (LoreForever_Voice_<voice>_Alliance/_Horde, the places and people of that faction's zones plus the contested ones) and a complete bundle; /download/voice/<pack id> serves them, and a site path is linked as it is. The included voice's lands packs come in the main zip, so it lists none of those. A pack in another language (LOR-177: LoreForever_Voice_<Default|Female>_<locale>, one per narrator and language) has its 'language'; status soon keeps a pack off every page (and its download a 404) until it's released. (The answers packs, LOR-227, are retired: LOR-561, Willo reads the short answers aloud.) Pack ids follow the same rules.

voices.name: Lore Forever male narrator
voices.coverage: selected zone, capital and dungeon stories, places and people, and dungeon bosses (other entries stay available as text; quest dialogue is a separate optional download)
voices.tagline: Has narrated every capital in one sitting. Doesn't blink. Declined our offer of water.
voices.bio:
The voice that comes with Lore Forever, and the first one you hear in Stormwind.

Has narrated every capital in one sitting. Doesn't blink. Declined our offer of water, then a chair, then a lunch break. Knows the founding of Stormwind by heart and will tell you about it whether or not you asked.

Favourite zone: all of them, in alphabetical order. Hobbies: dramatic pauses, and saying "Thrall" exactly right every single time.

voices.tagline: Asked for the candles lit and every murloc removed from the building. Got the candles.
voices.bio:
The second house voice, and an optional download: pick her in Options once she's installed.

Asked for the candles lit and every murloc removed from the building. Got the candles. Rumoured to have read the whole of Durotar aloud to a very patient kodo, twice, because the kodo asked.

Takes her tea the way the lore takes its villains: dark, and with a long backstory.

voices.name: Lore Forever original male narrator
voices.coverage: the zone, capital and dungeon stories he recorded before the new male narrator took over (a story he never recorded, or whose text has changed since, plays in the new narrator's voice)
voices.tagline: Was here first. Mentions it only when asked, and then at length.
voices.bio:
The voice Lore Forever launched with, and an optional download now that a new male narrator reads the stories that come with it. Install him and he goes to the top of your voices in Options, so his stories play first again.

Handed over the main download without a fuss and kept every story he'd already told. Still pauses before "Thrall" as if the name might hear him.

Knows the Barrens better than the Barrens do. Will not be drawn on which narrator is better.
